description: This file defines the CharacterRenderer class responsible for rendering special characters and symbols to RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering system.

classes.name: CharacterRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a specific character or symbol to RTF format, extending RendererBase.

methods.name: CharacterRenderer (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CharacterRenderer with a DocumentObject and RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the associated character or symbol to RTF output.
